items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued October 30 at 5:35PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
Isolated to scattered showers are expected across the coastal
waters through Sunday morning. Late tonight through Saturday
morning, there is a very low but present risk of waterspouts
across the inner waters south of Point Conception including
nearshore. Waterspouts are dangerous and can capsize boats.
Never move closer to investigate or take photos. The best
way to avoid a waterspout is to move at a 90 degree angle
to its apparent movement.
